run_readwriteurdf_cli: run the python module to read a URDF file and write it to an output file using argparse CLI
load_urdf_with_bullet_client: create a BulletClient in DIRECT mode and load a URDF file using loadURDF with flags
edit_urdf_with_urdf_editor: create a UrdfEditor instance and initialize it from a loaded Bullet body to modify URDF content
save_urdf_to_file: use the UrdfEditor saveUrdf method to write the edited URDF to an output file path
set_pybullet_search_path: set an additional search path for PyBullet data using setAdditionalSearchPath and getDataPath
